newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume fell at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Total turnover shrank to 45,140 denars from 1.557 million denars with 48 shares changing hands, down from 876 at the last trading on Thursday.
Oteks joint stock company traded on the third floor, where unlisted firms trade, selling 28 shares at 280 denars, up 130 denars from Thursday's close but below par of 1,941 denars.
A total of 20 Gradski Targovski Centar stocks sold on the first floor at 1,865 denars, unchanged from Thursday but below par of 2,664 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades twice a week. ($1=41.05 denars; 1DEM=26.64 denars) -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-981 4145
